x: Bottom left: Clive Holmes was our second man home in the Youths race and a few weeks later took our Junior Club Championship. Bottom right: John Searle was 28th in the County Championship, our third Youth.
Newcomer Clive Holmes nearly got into the medals and looks a useful asset to our Youths team. (We since hear that he has emigrated to Australia.)
Clive Holmes took the Junior Club Championship over 5 miles in 32:23 with Mark Waller 2nd 34:41, Brian Marmion 3rd 35:21 and David Bailey 4th 38:17.
